$comment: Contract for data/tables/know_how_reads.csv. Checked by build/src/schema.js.
title: Know-how reads
description: Which sources were read for makers' know-how, how, when and by whom: one row per source and scope. It is the one fact about know-how the build cannot derive, because a document with no statement recorded from it may have been read and found silent, or never read. The build reads it with the statements (evidence.csv, Domain "Makers' know-how") to give every product and material its know-how state: collected, sheet silent (maker site not yet searched), searched with nothing published, or no document read (build/src/know-how.js, DATA-MODEL.md).

fields.name: SourceID
fields.description: The source read. The products it speaks for are the ones the tables already link to it: a grade's own source, a profile's or a measurement's, or its Applicable grades.

fields.name: Scope
fields.description: How it was read: a document already held, read in full, or the maker's site searched.

fields.name: Read on
fields.description: The date it was read (YYYY-MM-DD). A maker-site search that found nothing is dated by this.

fields.name: Read by
fields.description: Who read it, and in which migration: a person, or an agent named as one.
